feedbackPlacement.authority: MainViewModel StatusKey, TechnicalError, operation/status origin and busy state; local regions are stateless projections
feedbackPlacement.local: Analyze form and command area, Export Copy/Save area, and History heading/load-retry context
feedbackPlacement.global: Other application contexts and active operations away from their originating page or Analyze mode; shell shares PageHost measure, capped at 1120 epx on large windows
feedbackPlacement.announcementOwner: Only the visible local feedback text is Polite when locally owned; otherwise the existing shell text is Polite. The inactive owner is Off and hidden
feedbackPlacement.lifecycle: Settled navigation clears feedback; busy navigation preserves it. Input edits expire existing validation without revalidating. New commands clear settled feedback and technical detail. Async command origins and a central feedback revision prevent late results replacing a newer command
feedbackPlacement.focus: Feedback updates do not move keyboard focus; validation text is also exposed as input HelpText

sharedSurfaceStates.lists: Scoped semantic lists use AppSurface for ordinary rows, AppSurfaceMuted for hover, AppSelection for selected rows and retain visible keyboard focus and disabled text
sharedSurfaceStates.disclosures: Scoped semantic disclosures use AppSurfaceMuted headers, AppSurface expanded content, AppBorder divisions and retain Fluent chevrons, hover, focus, disabled and expanded behavior

screens.primaryQuestion: What should I do now and what did the last analysis show?
screens.emptyState: distinguish zero supported incidents from background-only results; retain any source coverage limits

responsiveRules.small: single content column; intrinsic compact navigation 160–208 epx; brand no wrap, ellipsis only if text scaling exceeds available width; summary counts stack together only when all labels cannot fit within available page width; 4 epx summary gap; 12 epx gutter
responsiveRules.medium: three summary actions stay on one row only when all fit available page content width; 4 epx summary gap; 24 epx gutter
responsiveRules.large: constrained 1120 epx content; three intrinsic summary actions remain compact and aligned

screens.summaryLayout: Three accessible count actions use three intrinsic columns when all labels fit the actual Home content width; otherwise they form one full-width column without a 2+1 orphan row

screens.primaryQuestion: What kind of analysis matches what happened?
screens.loadingState: existing progress text before Analyze/Cancel, indeterminate progress below; shell owns ongoing visibility while away
screens.errorState: existing validation/failure text between inputs/source disclosure and primary action; technical details stay subordinate

responsiveRules.small: wrap subnavigation naturally; stack existing fields and actions
responsiveRules.large: left-align form content at an 800 epx maximum; use available width below that

screens.datePresentationCulture: Native Avalonia DatePicker follows Windows regional culture; app-owned labels and timestamp summaries follow the selected FaultWitness language
screens.navigationState: Analyze is the initial subpage; the shell remembers the last Analyze/Capture subpage. Explicit recent/around/import links select Analyze. Existing mode views and form inputs remain cached.

screens.userGoal: scan and filter all retained current results
screens.emptyState: state whether no analysis or no matches

responsiveRules.small: one-column filter fields below 680 epx available content width; Search stretches and each label stays with its control
responsiveRules.medium: two-column aligned filter pairs from 680 to under 920 epx available content width
responsiveRules.large: three aligned selectors at 920 epx or more available content width; Search spans a stable full row; dense list width remains constrained for scanning

screens.datePresentationCulture: Native Avalonia DatePicker follows Windows regional culture; app-owned labels and timestamp summaries follow the selected FaultWitness language
forbiddenPatterns: raw Event IDs in main row

screens.userGoal: understand evidence and next diagnostic step
screens.primaryQuestion: What happened, what should I do, what does the evidence suggest, and what does it not establish?
screens.primaryAction: none; diagnostic result and best next step have visual priority
screens.unavailableFallback: content-sized bordered surface aligned at the top, retaining the existing explanation and navigation/help content

responsiveRules.small: single reading column; natural wrapping; no horizontal scrolling; compact navigation and 12 epx gutter
responsiveRules.medium: single reading column; natural wrapping; no horizontal scrolling; 24 epx gutter
responsiveRules.large: single reading column; natural wrapping; no horizontal scrolling; content constrained to token reading width

defaultDisclosureState.materialCoverage: visible when limited or not examined
defaultDisclosureState.keyEvidence: open; all items retained, no top-N selection
defaultDisclosureState.timeline: collapsed; records and raw XML nested closed
defaultDisclosureState.changes: collapsed; header distinguishes relevant count / no relevant examined / not examined / limited / unavailable
defaultDisclosureState.otherSteps: collapsed when additional actions exist; omitted otherwise
defaultDisclosureState.technical: collapsed; records and raw XML nested closed

screens.primaryQuestion: What was analyzed before and what summary was retained?
screens.emptyState: Run an analysis to start building local history only when not loading and no existing local HistoryError is present
screens.loadingState: existing local loading text; suppress the confident empty claim
screens.errorState: existing HistoryError near the heading with Refresh history and subordinate technical details; retained rows and current result survive

responsiveRules.small: one column; list then independently scrollable detail separated by a 16 epx canonical gap; hide empty list/detail panels when no saved analysis exists
responsiveRules.medium: one column; list then independently scrollable detail separated by a 16 epx canonical gap; hide empty list/detail panels when no saved analysis exists
responsiveRules.large: 40/60 master-detail with 16 epx heading-to-body gap; independently scrollable detail; selected row uses subtle surface and accent indicator

screens.userGoal: understand system identity and diagnostic capability
screens.primaryQuestion: What system data and diagnostic sources are available?
screens.primaryAction: none; existing read-only information loads automatically on first visit
forbiddenPatterns: Capture host or route inside System

screens.userGoal: explicitly prepare stronger evidence for a future application crash
screens.primaryQuestion: What is observed, what would change, and can the previous setting be restored safely?
secondaryActions: Configure after preview and architecture confirmation
Restore recorded previous state after authoritative guards
screens.emptyState: single title and unavailable text without service; otherwise no recorded changes
screens.loadingState: operation in progress, disabled actions; Pending never implies success
screens.errorState: existing workflow result code and refusal explanation; cancellation remains distinct

responsiveRules.small: single column; full safety prose remains open above Configure; translated text and commands wrap at 560/600/640/641
responsiveRules.medium: single reading column; natural command wrapping; previous-state summary stays next to each Restore candidate
responsiveRules.large: left-aligned reading column capped at the existing 800 epx form measure inside Analyze at 1008/1280/1920

screens.feedbackOwnership: Exactly one visible Polite owner: preview notice before a result, operation text while busy, otherwise latest result. Verification, Restore refusal and journal text remain readable without duplicate live announcements. Historical Pending remains unverified and is not promoted to a current result. While away from Capture, ongoing workflow activity projects its existing localized running text into the shell; the detached local view does not announce it. Existing analysis feedback retains its owner and priority; Capture has no new cancellation command.
forbiddenPatterns: independent result or Restore safety decisions
raw technical values as primary policy summary
screens.navigationState: One cached CaptureView/presentation under Analyze; first entry initializes the existing read-only refresh. Later navigation preserves target, invalidated or prepared Preview, architecture acknowledgement, journal and disclosures without another automatic read.

screens.fieldAlignment: Analysis and Privacy selectors share the left inset of the General language selector

screens.userGoal: preview and export a privacy-safe result
screens.primaryQuestion: What will be included and redacted?
screens.loadingState: existing Copy/Save availability; no new export busy state or progress algorithm
screens.errorState: existing Copy/Save success or failure text immediately before commands; subordinate technical disclosure and unchanged silent picker cancellation

responsiveRules.large: single reading column; options precede the full-width preview
